title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Numbness and tingling in both feet.

HPI
The patient is a 64-year-old male presenting for a follow-up regarding symptoms of polyneuropathy. He reports a persistent "pins and needles" sensation in his toes and the soles of his feet, which has gradually worsened over the last six months. He describes the sensation as a dull ache that is more noticeable at night. He has been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes mellitus and has been managed with medication for several years. He denies any acute injury to the feet or sudden onset of weakness.

Medication List
Metformin 1000mg daily.

Exam
General: Alert and oriented x3. Extremities: Symmetrical sensation is diminished in the distal lower extremities. Skin is intact without ulcerations or breaks. Pedal pulses are palpable and strong. Reflexes are diminished at the ankles.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes
2. Polyneuropathy

Plan
Continue current oral hypoglycemic regimen. Patient advised to monitor for any skin breakdown or sores on the feet. Follow up in three months for a repeat neurological exam and laboratory workup.
explanations: Polyneuropathy is listed under 'with' for diabetes: the combination code E11.42 captures both.
Long-term oral hypoglycemic use: add Z79.84.

distractors.why: Coding the two separately misses the presumed link.
Z79.84 captures long-term oral hypoglycemic use.
